description: This file defines a final class CommonParams within the OrangeHRM project. The class contains a set of constant string parameters used for API communication, such as identifiers, sorting, pagination, and totals. It appears to serve as a centralized location for common parameter keys used in the API layer of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.
